title: Anchor Notes v0.18.0发布：移动端应用上线及全平台设计重做
originalTitle: Anchor Notes: a self-hosted Google Keep alternative, now with a full redesign, highlights and a slash menu
summary: Anchor Notes v0.18.0发布，Android应用上线Google Play，iOS测试版开放，全平台设计重做并新增分享功能。用户提交的漏洞修复贡献显著，GitHub星数两周内增长1400+。
